## Popularity of the Name James Over Time

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-james
# Read baby names data
baby_names <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Filter for the name James
james_data <- baby_names |>
  filter(name == "James")

# Plot trend over time
james_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, color = sex)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of the Name 'James' Over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
